prompt: Explain parturition.
Which term fits this definition? The process of labour and birth.
Correct this incorrect statement: Parturition is another word for fertilization.
Name the term described: The process of labour and birth.
Explain cervical dilation.
Which term fits this definition? Widening of the cervix during labour.
Correct this incorrect statement: Cervical dilation is the release of milk.
Name the term described: Widening of the cervix during labour.
Explain oxytocin.
Which term fits this definition? A hormone made in the hypothalamus and released by the posterior pituitary that supports uterine contractions and milk ejection.
Correct this incorrect statement: Oxytocin is made by the placenta to manufacture milk.
Name the term described: A hormone made in the hypothalamus and released by the posterior pituitary that supports uterine contractions and milk ejection.
Explain positive feedback.
Which term fits this definition? A response that reinforces the initiating change.
Correct this incorrect statement: Positive feedback always returns a variable toward its starting value.
Name the term described: A response that reinforces the initiating change.
Explain lactation.
Which term fits this definition? Milk production and secretion by the mammary glands.
Correct this incorrect statement: Lactation is controlled only by progesterone.
Name the term described: Milk production and secretion by the mammary glands.
Explain prolactin.
Which term fits this definition? An anterior-pituitary hormone that stimulates milk production.
Correct this incorrect statement: Prolactin’s main action is squeezing milk out of ducts.
Name the term described: An anterior-pituitary hormone that stimulates milk production.
Explain milk ejection.
Which term fits this definition? Movement of milk toward the nipple through contraction of cells around mammary secretory structures.
Correct this incorrect statement: Milk ejection and milk synthesis are identical events.
Name the term described: Movement of milk toward the nipple through contraction of cells around mammary secretory structures.
Explain suckling reflex.
Which term fits this definition? A neural and hormonal response initiated by sensory stimulation during feeding.
Correct this incorrect statement: Milk itself must travel to the brain to trigger the reflex.
Name the term described: A neural and hormonal response initiated by sensory stimulation during feeding.
